item.title: Reporting commands and requests with told and asked
item.explanation_text:
When you pass on an instruction, name the person who gave it and the person who received it. For a command, use told + person + to + base verb. For a polite request, use asked + person + to + base verb. For example, if Omar says to Nina, “Could you check the microphone, please?” you can report it as “Omar asked Nina to check the microphone.”

For a negative instruction, this lesson uses not to + base verb: “Omar told Nina not to move the microphone.” You can also use asked + person + not to for a polite request. Keep the receiver between told or asked and the infinitive. If you are Nina and you tell a teammate what Omar said to you, use me: “Omar told me not to move the microphone.” Me shows who received the instruction.
item.contrast_text: In the studio, Kai says directly to Lena, “Lock the equipment cabinet.” Later, Lena messages Sam, their studio teammate: “Kai told me to lock the equipment cabinet.” In Lena’s message, me refers to Lena, who received the instruction.
item.common_error_pattern: Keep the receiver after told or asked and before to or not to. Use an object form such as me or him. Follow to with the base verb.

examples.bad: The guide told us stay on the path.
examples.good: The guide told us to stay on the path.

examples.bad: The receptionist asked we to sign the visitor book.
examples.good: The receptionist asked us to sign the visitor book.

examples.bad: The instructor told the class not to touching the wet paint.
examples.good: The instructor told the class not to touch the wet paint.

examples.bad: Priya asked Ben to copies the link.
examples.good: Priya asked Ben to copy the link.

children.title: Set out the trays
children.instructions: The chef gave Jo a command. Use the past form of tell.
children.prompt_text: The chef ___ Jo to set out the trays.

children.title: Lower the blind
children.instructions: Use the past form of ask to report the librarian’s polite request to Theo.
children.prompt_text: The librarian ___ Theo to lower the blind.

children.title: Keep the gate closed
children.instructions: The keeper said to Imani, “Don’t open the gate.” Use two words to fill the gap. Put not immediately before to.
children.prompt_text: The keeper told Imani ___ open the gate.

children.title: Identify the caller
children.instructions: Mae said to Luca, “Please call the ticket office.” Luca uses he/him pronouns. Complete the report with the object pronoun for Luca.
children.prompt_text: Mae asked ___ to call the ticket office.

children.title: Send the seating plan
children.instructions: The organizer said to Rosa, “Send the seating plan.” Complete the report with two words, using send as the action verb.
children.prompt_text: The organizer told Rosa ___ the seating plan.

children.title: Check the batteries
children.instructions: Add the one missing word to fix the report. Keep all the original words.
children.prompt_text: The stage manager told Wes check the batteries.
accepted_answers: The stage manager told Wes to check the batteries.

children.title: Protect the labels
children.instructions: Replace don't with two words. Put not immediately before to and leave the other words in place.
children.prompt_text: The lab assistant asked the visitors don't remove the labels.
accepted_answers: The lab assistant asked the visitors not to remove the labels.

children.title: Message a studio teammate
children.instructions: Write the report as Emi in a message to your studio teammate. Start with “Dario told me” and keep the action and time from the quote.
children.prompt_text: Dario said to Emi, “Switch off the desk lamp after the shoot.”
accepted_answers: Dario told me to switch off the desk lamp after the shoot.

children.title: Pass on a favor
children.instructions: Report the request starting with “Nadia asked him.” Use him for Pavel and report the action and object using the words from the quote.
children.prompt_text: Nadia said to Pavel, “Could you print the updated map, please?”
accepted_answers: Nadia asked him to print the updated map.

children.title: Report a team reminder
children.instructions: Start with “The coordinator asked us”. Use the words “not to leave any boxes” and keep the place from the quote.
children.prompt_text: The coordinator said to the volunteers, “Please don’t leave any boxes in the hallway.”
accepted_answers: The coordinator asked us not to leave any boxes in the hallway.

children.title: Put the delivery report in order
children.instructions: Use every tile once to report the command. Start with “The driver” and put “by the side door” at the end.
children.prompt_text: by the side door / told / to / the parcel / The driver / Alex / leave
accepted_answers: The driver told Alex to leave the parcel by the side door.

children.title: Put the recording request in order
children.instructions: Use every tile once to report the request. Start with “The host” and put “not” immediately before “to.”
children.prompt_text: record / the guests / not / The host / the interview / to / asked
accepted_answers: The host asked the guests not to record the interview.
